comment: Shared activation precedence matrix. UMonolithSettings (C++) and monolith_activation_state.ps1 (offline scripts) must resolve every case identically; the scripts exist because they run with no editor, so the rule is necessarily implemented twice. Only the layer both implement is covered here: per-user override vs legacy migration source vs resolved project default. The plugin-vs-project DefaultMonolith.ini layering is script-only and stays in MonolithActivationState.Tests.ps1. Expected serverUserSet/indexingUserSet mean the value came from a user or legacy key rather than the project default.

cases.name: no override inherits the project default
user override wins over the project default
legacy value is honoured when no user key exists
user key wins over a conflicting legacy key
partial user override leaves the sibling on project policy
malformed user value fails closed without touching the sibling
a pre-default-on Stop choice is not silently re-enabled
partial legacy key migrates only its own feature
